fact: President Lourenço says programmes such as N'gola Digital, Escola Conectada and Conecta Angola brought connectivity to communities including remote areas via ANGOSAT-2, and that strengthening connectivity in rural communities is a priority for coming years.

ANGOP reports that ANGOSAT-2, a government space programme project, has let operators install more than 150 VSAT terminals in remote localities across 16 of 18 provinces, and that the government's Conecta Angola platform was launched in June 2023 to extend internet to unserved zones.

MINTTICS says its Conecta Angola project, launched in June 2023 to bring voice and internet to remote areas operators do not serve, has reached more than 300,000 people previously without communications, per GGPEN director-general Zolana João.
